thread:
maddie (AE): AuroraLabs asked for a concise POC run to validate UX latency and burst resilience. Target: steady 550 qps (chat), occasional spikes to 2k qps for ~90s. p99 target <= 350ms. Need runbook + a two-option price (hosted vs 6mo dedicated).
vik (SE): noted. Model preference? 7b-quant default, but they want a 13b option if cost allows. Also confirm avg tokens; they said ~85 tokens per request.
sanjay (SRE): initial infra note: steady 550 qps with 7b-quant should fit on 2 GPUs with good batching and KV hotness; 2k microbursts need ~3-4 GPUs for safety. I'll simulate later today.
maddie (AE): security: SOC2 and CMK required; might push for private VPC if they move forward.
isabel (Security): checklist: SOC2 yes; KMS with customer-managed keys supported (HSM optional); IP allowlist; audit logs retention default 30d; we can scope shorter retention on request. Share their SecQ if they have one.
kevin (SalesEng): pricing ask: provide a simple hosted estimate based on tokens and a reserved-dedicated ballpark. Show GPU-equivalent math to help procurement.
vik (SE): proposed test plan: warmup 10m; steady 40m at 550 qps; three microbursts (90s to 2k qps) separated by 10m cool-downs; 1 cold-start spike after a pod restart. Capture p50/p95/p99/99.9 latencies, batches/sec, avg batch size, cache hit-rate, GPU util, and error rates.
sanjay (SRE): add OS-level metrics and container restart traces. Tag metrics with model_variant for 7b vs 13b.
isabel (Security): flag: if they require HSM for CMK, timeline extends. Notify customer early.
maddie (AE): can someone draft a one-page runbook and a short checklist I can send by EOD?
vik (SE): I'll attach Locust and wrk scripts plus a minimal python streaming client. Sample wrk cmd in runbook.
sanjay (SRE): rough cost heuristics: with 7b-quant and caching, hosted cost estimate ~ $0.015-0.025 per 1k tokens depending on usage pattern. Dedicated 24/7 for burst headroom (3-4 A10 equiv) ~ $17k-$26k/mo depending on commit and region. 13b roughly 2x. I'll validate with sim and post final numbers.
kevin (SalesEng): include fallback options: route to lower-cost quant variant on overload, or degrade max tokens. We'll show example routing policy.
deploy-bot: Test endpoint will be provisioned: https://test.redwood.dev/aurora by 2025-04-10T11:30:00Z
maddie (AE): thanks all. Action items: vik = runbook + scripts; sanjay = infra sim + final price; isabel = security checklist; kevin = routing fallback brief. I'll schedule kickoff with AuroraLabs for Thu 9am PT and request anonymized traffic sample.
vik (SE): will post scripts in channel and link the run report template. Keep messages terse in the report for procurement.
